# Owned primary-context diagnostics

These 28 frozen fixtures contain 14 explicitly requested subjects and 14 adjacent printed-caption controls. The pairs cover a constructed golem, ceramic automaton, wyvern, earth-diver, karaoke friends, rail-switch actuator, living armor, legend teller, storm cell, solar prominence, mycelium, seagrass, doctor and witch. Each pair mixes Korean and English source requests. The caption controls keep an ordinary physical primary subject while the special phrase appears on a separate printed card.

The complete request envelope, authorial core, neutral creative controls, embodiment review and freeze receipt were prepared before implementation. The English core is the authorial representation of the source request. This is targeted maintenance evidence, not a fresh blind holdout, a Korean free-form subtype parser evaluation, final composition proof or an image render.

Run `tests.test_photo_subject_context_retrieval` for predicate and projection regressions. The public candidate-pack CLI must also preserve the frozen hashes, include each explicitly requested target within the existing caps and omit that target for its caption control. A predicate pass alone does not establish public rank/admission.

`../owner_focus_v1.json` separately holds 12 frozen owner/property projection probes. Those partial cores test query ownership in Korean and English; they are not complete public authorial-pack fixtures. Role and remaining-carrier label probes in the unit test are source-derived predicate checks and are reported separately from these 28 requests.
